title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region residency + audit hardening
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: enforce KMS key region residency and audit logging at the RBAC v2 policy layer. Many customers require proof that KMS-backed secrets and keys are pinned to an allowed region; current enforcement lived in two places (runtime and operator heuristics) and produced inconsistent audit trails. This PR centralizes region residency enforcement in the RBAC v2 policy evaluator, adds audit events for KMS-binding operations, adds a DB migration to record KMS region at resource creation time, and hardens telemetry for post-incident analysis. Changes include policy language extensions, enforcement hooks in the evaluator, KMS client metadata propagation, enhanced audit schema, and console + CLI visibility. Checklist: [x] policy AST + evaluator hooks implemented; [x] KMS client annotated with region metadata; [x] audit events added and documented; [x] DB migration included and tested; [x] unit + integration tests; [x] docs updated; [x] e2e in staging passed. Related: ENG-4321, SEC-210. Testing notes: unit tests for policy evaluator and kms client, integration test using local KMS mock to simulate region mismatch and matching flows, staging canary run validated canary customers with pinned keys. Rollout: feature-gated behind 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce' with default set to audit mode; will flip to enforce for enterprise tenants after 2-week monitoring window.

patch_summary: Added kms_region field to secrets and key_binding models and migration
Extended RBAC v2 policy language with 'kms_region == <region>' predicate
Policy evaluator will return DENY on mismatched kms_region when feature flag is enforce
Audit subsystem records KMS_BIND and KMS_UNBIND events with region metadata
KMS client now returns region as part of Create/Bind responses and surfaces to API layer
Console shows region pinning details in policy editor and resource overlays
Added unit and integration tests and test fixtures for region mismatch scenarios
review_comments: Liu Chen: requested change - include kms_region in the policy evaluation trace log so SRE can query traces for denied decisions based on region. Please add structured field 'audit.kms_region' to the evaluator trace.
Aisha Patel (author): responded - added structured trace field and unit tests to assert trace payload contains audit.kms_region
Sofia Martinez: asked for explicit migration rollback notes and a DB size estimate; also requested an e2e in staging with a customer-like dataset.
Aisha Patel: responded - added rollback SQL and size estimate (approx +12MB per 10k secret rows), staged e2e run completed successfully and results attached to the Linear task.
Marco Rossi: approved - small nits fixed (log level and comment typos). Approved for squash merge after CI passes.
ci_flaky_fixes: Initial integration run failed due to KMS mock mismatch; fixed mocking harness and re-ran. All subsequent runs green.
notes_on_backward_compatibility: Default behavior is audit-only. Enforcement is behind feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce' and must be opt-in for existing customers. Migration adds nullable column and backfills from existing key_binding metadata where available.
release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 now supports KMS region residency enforcement and records KMS binding/unbinding with region metadata. Ship in audit mode by default; enforcement gated by feature flag. See docs/rbac/v2/kms-region-residency.md for migration and rollout steps.
deployment_instructions: Apply DB migration, deploy service with feature flag set to 'audit' for 2 weeks, monitor 'audit.kms_region' denied events and latency, then flip flag to 'enforce' for targeted tenants. Coordinate with SRE for canary policy across regions.
post_merge_actions: Notify enterprise customers 72h prior to enforce flip
Run backfill job for kms_region nulls if needed using elide-backfill tool
